certification.name: IBM Cybersecurity Fundamentals Professional Certificate
certification.description: Four-course IBM program covering cybersecurity tools and attacks, operating system security, compliance frameworks and database security. Course-based certificate assessed through labs and a final project, with no proctored exam.
certification.currency_note: Program bundle price $536.40 shown on the edX page (list $596 for the courses bought separately); one-off payment, not a subscription.
